implementation_state: Designed, not implemented. An opt-in provider that reaches OpenCode's anonymous free tier at https://opencode.ai/zen with no login (Bearer public). Reuses the OpenAI Chat Completions egress and adds a locked 'opencode' shaping identity: the free-tier gate is satisfied by forcing stream:true, ensuring tools named bash and read, a User-Agent containing opencode/<ver>=1.18.0, and a canonical ses_ session (12 lowercase hex + 14 base62). Session/request ids port DaatLocus's opencode_identifier. Non-streaming clients get the forced SSE collapsed into a ChatResponse. Discovery is GET /zen/v1/models for ids plus the capability catalog models.opencode.ai/api.json for capabilities, windows and the free flag (cost==0). The free tier is rate-limited per egress IP (429 FreeUsageLimitError), so a proxy pool is a throughput lever. Serves main traffic only: excluded from the Auto Mode classifier and from election probes.
required_gates: Shaped request passes the free-tier gate (no 403 FreeTierError)
Identifier shape ^ses_[0-9a-f]{12}[0-9A-Za-z]{14}$ with no sequential run
bash+read tool injection for 0/1/many client tool sets
Non-streaming collapse preserves text, thinking, tool calls and usage
Parser tolerates usage-per-chunk, null deltas and the {"choices":[],"cost":"0"} trailer
Discovery derives ids from /v1/models and never hand-derives them
unblock_condition: Not blocked; design complete and ready for implementation.
notes: Field-verified 2026-10 via a local reverse proxy capture plus per-item bisection; see docs/development/opencode-zen.md.
big-pickle is free but its id contains no 'free' substring, so free detection must use the catalog cost, not the name.
